# Template:RepoLink

<div class="mw-parser-output">

A template for linking to example files in content repos.

e.g.

    &#123;&#123;RepoLink
    |root = http://imolarpg.dyndns.org/trac/balatest/browser/trunk
    |path = /gamedata/explosions
    |name = Balanced Annihilation
    |entity = CEGs
    |info = (TDF format)
    &#125;&#125;

Result:

<a href="http://imolarpg.dyndns.org/trac/balatest/browser/trunk/gamedata/explosions" class="external text" rel="nofollow">'Balanced Annihilation' CEGs</a> (TDF format)

</div>
